689:t_020:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「Let's do it, $$真化融合$$!」

689:t_021:0.en:
$n
「Let's do this, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

689:t_021:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I can feel it! Right now, $$マジンガー$$ and I have become one!」

689:t_021:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It draws power out of your bodies of steel, and makes your hearts even stronger!」

689:t_021:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Our feelings and our power are rising...!」

689:t_021:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Incredible...! Power is overflowing from the machine!」

689:t_021:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The machines... and we... have evolved... No, have we undergone Shinka!?」

689:t_021:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$真化融合$$... Looks like it was a success.」

689:t_021:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「I knew all of you could pull it off!」

689:t_021:12.en:
$$カトル$$
「So you'll fight alongside us, too.」

689:t_021:13.en:
$$エスター$$
「Of course! After all, I'm part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$... I mean, I'm part of $c!」

689:t_021:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you to handle the $$ソーラリアン$$'s power control. I'm expecting great things from you, $$エスター$$.」

689:t_021:15.en:
$$エスター$$
「Thank you, Chief... For working so hard, all this time, to save me...」

689:t_021:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Finding a way through what we don't understand and can't do is just a scientist's nature.」

689:t_021:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm leaving the $$ソーラリアン$$ to you, $$エスター$$!」

689:t_022:1.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Come on, $$シモン$$! I'm ready whenever you are!」

689:t_023:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, $$グレンラガン$$! Tengen Toppa!!」

689:t_024:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So that's the one we've heard about...!」

689:t_024:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「So that's the one we've heard about...!」

689:t_024:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「So that's the one we've heard about...!」

689:t_024:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$!」

689:t_024:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「This $$カオス・コスモス$$ is the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s universe. Here, existence is perceived through will.」

689:t_024:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The Spiral Man has now become completely one with the spiral... with the drill. Nothing is left that can stop him.」

689:t_024:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! It's useless to try to rule our hearts and stop our evolution!」

689:t_024:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Just as we promised the $$アンチスパイラル$$, we'll defeat you and protect the universe!」

689:t_024:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「My will has not changed.」

689:t_024:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Stop them here, even if it costs you your lives.」

689:t_024:14.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We will surely live up to your expectations!」

689:t_025:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So they tucked their tails and ran, huh!」

689:t_025:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's not how it looked to me...」

689:t_025:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is their universe, after all. There's no running or hiding for us anymore.」

689:t_025:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then all we can do is move forward!」

689:t_025:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「For someone under the protection of emissary of God, you seem rattled.」

689:t_025:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「There's nothing left for us to fear!」

689:t_025:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll gather all our power and fight you!」

689:t_025:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that we can carve out our future with our own hands!」

689:t_025:9.en:
$n
「By overcoming every one of those obstacles!」

689:t_025:11.en:
$n
「$$マキ#pilot$$... We can't afford to stop...!」

689:t_025:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we come, servant of the $$御使い$$s! Right now, we're a drill that drags everything along as it plows forward!」

689:t_025:14.en:
$$シモン$$
「We carry our comrades' feelings and our machines' feelings with us, and we're moving forward!!」

689:t_026:1.en:
$$渓$$
「All right...! We won the first battle by a landslide!」

689:t_027:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief... Is there a way back to our world from this $$カオス・コスモス$$?」

689:t_027:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Who knows... I can't say either way at this point.」

689:t_027:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Can't we at least tell what things are like over there? I want to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ turned out.」

689:t_027:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Can't we at least tell what things are like over there? I want to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ turned out.」

689:t_027:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Can't we at least tell what things are like over there? I want to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ turned out.」

689:t_027:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I think it's precisely because the $$時空震動弾$$ went off that those of us who were there were able to come to this universe...」

689:t_028:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warriors of Earth. Thanks to your victory, $$バアル$$ have vanished into the gap between dimensions.」

689:t_028:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Intelligent life will unite its strength and drive out the remaining $$バアル$$.」

689:t_028:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Correct. Unless the $$御使い$$s are defeated, no time of rest will ever come to intelligent life.」

689:t_028:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... When it comes to defeating the $$御使い$$s, your goal and ours are the same.」

689:t_028:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll set aside the fact that you tried to use Earth and its people for now. Won't you join hands with us?」

689:t_028:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why not?! We're saying this while holding back our anger, too!」

689:t_028:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...If you want the $$御使い$$s defeated, hand over the four $$スフィア$$s you carry.」

689:t_028:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We can't hand power over to someone who refuses to accept others.」
